singleSourced.context: According to the report from GamesBeat, which cites "four industry sources familiar with the studio's plans", the first three months of 2027 make up the window during which Rockstar intend to bring Grandma Stealy Wheely 6 to PC.
In September, Rockstar paid just shy of $1 million to install a massive, glowing "Welcome to Vice City" sign on top of the Miami Heat's arena, the Kaseya Center.
If true, it would mean GTA 6 hitting PC just a few months after it launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S on November 19, 2026.
